title: Several New Integral Inequalities of Hermite–Hadamard Type for Extended ϕh-s-Convex Functions
content: In the paper, the authors modify the definitions of ϕh-s-convex functions and extended ϕh-s-convex functions, establish two new integral identities and, by virtue of these two integral identities, present several new integral inequalities of the Hermite–Hadamard type for extended ϕh-s-convex functions.
